objects.description: One instrument somebody is asked to fill in, and the lifecycle it moves through from draft to closed.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers.

fields.name: title
fields.description: What the instrument is called, in one line.

fields.name: originator_chapter_id
fields.description: The group that composed it, and whose listing it appears in.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Where it has got to: composed, sent for a decision, cleared, taking answers, or finished.

fields.name: opens_at
fields.description: When it starts taking answers. Empty means the moment it is published.

fields.name: closes_at
fields.description: When it stops taking answers.

fields.name: published_at
fields.description: When it was opened for answers.

fields.name: published_by
fields.description: Who opened it.

fields.name: closed_at
fields.description: When it stopped taking answers.

fields.name: closed_by
fields.description: Who closed it.

fields.name: submitted_at
fields.description: When it was last sent for a decision.

fields.name: submitted_by
fields.description: Who last sent it for a decision.

fields.name: approved_at
fields.description: When it was last cleared.

fields.name: approved_by
fields.description: Who last cleared it.

fields.name: results_published_at
fields.description: When what it collected was made readable to those who answered.

fields.name: created_by
fields.description: Who composed it.

fields.name: audience
fields.description: Whether it is aimed at known members or at anyone holding its link.

fields.name: collection_mode
fields.description: Whether the person answers it themselves or somebody records their answers for them.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When it was first written. Listings are ordered by it, because the storage key carries no order.

fields.name: last_updated
fields.description: When anything about it last changed.

indexes.name: originator
indexes.description: Reads one group's own instruments, which is the composing surface's listing.

indexes.name: status
indexes.description: Reads everything awaiting a decision, across every group.

objects.description: One prompt on an instrument, in the shape of answer it expects back. A published prompt is superseded rather than edited, so several rows may describe the same position.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers.

fields.name: form_id
fields.description: The instrument this prompt belongs to.

fields.name: ordinal
fields.description: Where it sits in the order the prompts are asked. Server-assigned.

fields.name: answer_type
fields.description: The shape of value this prompt expects back, which decides which value column an answer fills.

fields.name: prompt
fields.description: The question as it is put to the person answering.

fields.name: placeholder
fields.description: The greyed-out example shown in an empty field.

fields.name: max_length
fields.description: The longest free text accepted. Absent means no limit, which is not the same as a limit of zero.

fields.name: unit_label
fields.description: What a number is counted in, shown beside the field.

fields.name: helper
fields.description: The further explanation shown under the prompt.

fields.name: currency_code
fields.description: Which currency an amount is in.

fields.name: quick_picks
fields.description: The handful of amounts offered as one-tap answers.

fields.name: yes_label
fields.description: What the affirmative answer is called, where plain yes is wrong.

fields.name: no_label
fields.description: What the negative answer is called.

fields.name: version
fields.description: Which revision of this prompt it is. Server-assigned, counting from one.

fields.name: supersedes_question_id
fields.description: The prompt this one replaced. Empty for the first version, which is how a chain is walked back.

indexes.name: form
indexes.description: Reads one instrument's prompts, which every read of it does.

indexes.name: supersedes
indexes.description: Walks a prompt's revision chain, and finds whether one has been superseded.

objects.description: One choice a prompt offers, where the answer is picked from a list rather than typed.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers, and what an answer records as its pick.

fields.name: question_id
fields.description: The prompt offering this choice.

fields.name: ordinal
fields.description: Where it sits in the order the choices are shown.

fields.name: label
fields.description: The choice as it is shown to the person answering.

indexes.name: question
indexes.description: Reads one prompt's choices, which validating an answer does on every submission.

objects.description: One group a member-audience instrument is aimed at. A public-audience one carries none.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers.

fields.name: form_id
fields.description: The instrument being aimed.

fields.name: chapter_id
fields.description: The group it is aimed at.

fields.name: includes_descendants
fields.description: Whether it reaches the groups beneath that one too, or that one alone.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the aim was set. Listings are ordered by it, because the storage key carries no order.

indexes.name: form_chapter
indexes.description: Reads one instrument's aims, and refuses the same group twice.

objects.description: One round of sending an instrument for a decision, and what was decided. An undecided round is the open one.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers.

fields.name: form_id
fields.description: The instrument awaiting or holding the decision.

fields.name: requested_by
fields.description: Who asked for the decision.

fields.name: requested_at
fields.description: When it was asked for.

fields.name: decided_by
fields.description: Who decided. Empty while the round is still open.

fields.name: decided_at
fields.description: When it was decided. Empty is what makes a round the open one.

fields.name: decision
fields.description: Which way it went. Empty while the round is still open.

fields.name: note
fields.description: Why it went that way. Required to refuse.

indexes.name: form
indexes.description: Reads one instrument's decision history, newest first.

objects.description: How far a member-audience instrument has reached one group it was aimed at: written when it is published, and updated when that group picks it up.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers.

fields.name: form_id
fields.description: The instrument being spread.

fields.name: chapter_id
fields.description: The group it reached.

fields.name: state
fields.description: How far it has got with that group. Only targeted and picked_up are ever written; the other two are carried so a stored value from elsewhere still reads.

fields.name: targeted_at
fields.description: When the group was first reached.

fields.name: picked_up_at
fields.description: When the group took it up. Empty is exactly what stalled means.

fields.name: pushed_at
fields.description: When it was pushed onward from that group.

fields.name: pushed_by_chapter_id
fields.description: Which group pushed it onward.

fields.name: last_reminder_at
fields.description: When the group was last reminded. Nothing writes it yet.

indexes.name: form_chapter
indexes.description: Reads one instrument's spread, and keeps one row per group.

objects.description: The shareable, no-account way into a public-audience instrument, minted once when it is published.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers.

fields.name: form_id
fields.description: The instrument this opens.

fields.name: key
fields.description: The short token the link carries. Supplied by whoever publishes; this module stores it as given.

fields.name: label
fields.description: What this link was handed out as, so a rotation leaves a trail.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Whether the link still opens the instrument.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When it was minted.

fields.name: retired_at
fields.description: When it stopped working.

fields.name: created_by
fields.description: Who minted it.

indexes.name: form
indexes.description: Reads the links belonging to one instrument.

objects.description: Somebody answering through a public link, known only by a token their own device holds rather than by an account.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers.

fields.name: public_key
fields.description: The token the answering device holds, and the only handle on this person.

fields.name: first_seen_at
fields.description: When this token was first seen.

fields.name: claimed_by_member_id
fields.description: The member this person later turned out to be. Nothing writes it yet, and no public read returns it.

fields.name: claimed_at
fields.description: When they were matched to a member. Nothing writes it yet.

objects.description: Which group a public respondent says they belong to, for one instrument. Self-reported, never verified.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers.

fields.name: respondent_id
fields.description: Who is saying it.

fields.name: form_id
fields.description: The instrument they are saying it for.

fields.name: declared_chapter_id
fields.description: The group they picked from the list.

fields.name: declared_text
fields.description: What they typed instead, where no group on the list fitted.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When they said it. A repeat overwrites in place.

indexes.name: respondent_form
indexes.description: Reads a respondent's declaration for one instrument, and keeps it to one.

objects.description: One person's response to one prompt. Exactly one of the value columns carries it, decided by the prompt's own answer type.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers.

fields.name: form_id
fields.description: The instrument being answered.

fields.name: question_id
fields.description: The prompt being answered.

fields.name: member_id
fields.description: Who answered — a member, or a public respondent's own id.

fields.name: chapter_id
fields.description: The group they answered from, recorded once and kept across an edit.

fields.name: option_ids
fields.description: The choices picked, where the prompt offers a list.

fields.name: value_text
fields.description: What they typed, where the prompt asks for prose.

fields.name: value_number
fields.description: The amount given. Absent means unanswered, which is not the same as zero.

fields.name: value_date
fields.description: The day given, as YYYY-MM-DD.

fields.name: value_time
fields.description: The time of day given, as HH:MM.

fields.name: value_bool
fields.description: Which way they answered a yes-or-no. Absent means unanswered, which is not the same as no.

fields.name: answered_at
fields.description: When it was first answered. An edit leaves this alone.

fields.name: edited_at
fields.description: When it was last changed. Empty means never.

indexes.name: form
indexes.description: Counts how many people have answered one instrument.

indexes.name: question_member
indexes.description: Reads one person's answer to one prompt, and keeps it to one so a resubmission edits rather than doubles.
